You'll appreciate features like Electronic Stability Control, Blind Spot Warning, and an extensive array of airbags working together to protect you and your passengers. The braking system combines 4-wheel disc brakes with ABS technology and brake assist for reliable stopping power in all conditions.

Inside, you'll find a driver-focused cabin designed for long hours of comfortable operation. The heated front bucket seats adjust to your preferences, while the dual-zone automatic climate control keeps everyone comfortable. The leather steering wheel and intuitive steering wheel controls keep your focus on the road, and the wireless smartphone integration ensures your music, navigation, and calls are always within easy reach.

The PRO-4X Carpeted Floor Mats and split folding rear seat add practical touches that enhance daily usability. With power windows, power door mirrors, and telescoping steering wheel adjustment, personal customization is straightforward.
